exposure: Patient demographics (race, maternal age, years of education, parity)
outcome: Immediate postpartum long-acting reversible contraception (IPP LARC) desire
Immediate postpartum long-acting reversible contraception (IPP LARC) utilization
cohort: The study included 10,472 publicly insured patients delivering at one academic hospital in Tennessee between March 2018 and June 2023.
finding: Overall IPP LARC utilization was 24.1% during the immediate postpartum period, with patients who self-reported as non-Hispanic Black and non-Hispanic Other or multiple races utilizing IPP LARC less, while those with cesarean delivery or inadequate prenatal care were more likely to utilize it.
mod_finding: Patients with cesarean delivery were more likely to utilize immediate postpartum long-acting reversible contraception.
